text: Gate 2 landed via the vision-alignment epic: vignettes/introduction.Rmd now shows, from ONE plan_geometry() plan, the signed first-moment contrast beside the coherent/configuration/total energies (with the energy-vs-signed caution and the frame-weighted-orthogonality qualifier), the RDM, the RSA coefficient, and the admitted analytic SE — with hidden executable checks for exact recomposition (tol 1e-14) and planted-effect recovery (signal carried by configuration, null regions centred with ~half below zero).
